A '''wooden pickaxe''' is the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]], crafted from {{MCW|Planks|planks}}. It mines at speed 3 and has 200 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/wooden_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines pickaxe blocks at speed 3 (vanilla: 2).

It cannot get drops from [[Hematite|hematite]], [[Native Gold|native gold]], [[Native Silver|native silver]], diamond ore, [[Sulfurous Quartz Deposit|sulfurous quartz]] and [[Sulfur Deposit|sulfur deposits]], [[Natural Lapis Lazuli|natural lapis lazuli]], deepslate (including cobbled and polished deepslate) or obsidian-based blocks; it breaks them at speed 3 without dropping anything.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/wood.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 2 damage with an attack speed of 1.2.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Planks|planks}}. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).
